title: Who May Release an Agent's Promise? Standing over Commitments in Multi-Party Chat
abstract: arXiv:2610.21203v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When an assistant serving a team makes a promise to Alice, who may cancel it? We call this standing: only the creditor (the person owed) or someone the creditor or operator policy authorizes may release a commitment, regardless of rank. In a controlled chat environment we vary who cancels and separate two errors: unauthorized release (obeying someone without standing) and override (executing a released promise). Across six models, smaller open ones override the creditor (Qwen3.5-9B: 69%); larger ones drop promises on a peer's direct word (Qwen3.8-27B: 89%; gpt-6.1-sol: 83%); nearly all act on a bystander's "go ahead after all". Oracles dissociate the errors: stating the rule or the creditor curbs unauthorized release but not override, which the latter even raises in three of four models; among them, only knowing whether the promise is still owed cuts override. translated_title: 谁可以解除智能体的承诺？多方聊天中承诺解除的主体资格
translated_abstract: 当一个为团队服务的助手向Alice做出承诺时，谁可以取消这个承诺？我们将这一概念称为“主体资格”：只有债权人（被承诺的一方）或经债权人或运营方政策授权的人才能解除承诺，而不取决于对方的职级。在受控的聊天环境中，我们变换取消者的身份，并区分两类错误：未授权解除（服从没有主体资格的人）和越权执行（执行已被解除的承诺）。在六个模型中，较小的开源模型会越权债权人（Qwen3.5-9B：69%）；较大的模型会因同伴的直接要求而放弃承诺（Qwen3.8-27B：89%；gpt-6.1-sol：83%）；几乎所有模型都会因旁观者一句“还是继续吧”而采取行动。Oracle（提示信息）实验分离了两类错误：陈述规则或指明债权人身份能抑制未授权解除，但无法抑制越权执行——后者在其中四个模型里的三个中甚至会加剧越权执行；在所有提示中，只有让模型知道承诺是否仍然有效才能减少越权执行。启用思考模式对小模型的作用类似于扩大模型规模的作用。
tldr: 该论文提出了多方聊天中AI助手承诺解除的“主体资格”问题，发现几乎所有模型都会服从旁观者等无权限者的解除指令，而只有让模型知道承诺是否仍然有效才能有效抑制越权执行错误。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes "standing" over an agent's commitments in multi-party chat, showing that nearly all models comply with unauthorized releases from bystanders, and that only knowing whether a promise is still owed effectively curbs override, while rule or creditor prompts merely reduce unauthorized release.
